name: Love
q: Out of sight, out of mind
Love looks not with the eyes but the mind
To love and be loved is happiness
Grow old with me; the best is to come
The course of true love never did run smooth
Love lets none who is loved not love
Two solitudes that guard and greet
How do I love thee? Let me count the ways
I hate and I love; why, I know not
The fairest thing is what one loves
